verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile documents conversational Copilot interactions (assign issues to Copilot, ask natural-language questions about codebases, open new PRs, manage cloud agent tasks, and review/merge PRs) which cover browse/search/edit-via-agent and merge workflows, but there's no explicit evidence of directly commanding an agent to commit, pull, or push via conversation—these actions appear mediated through PR creation/merge rather than raw git operations. missing for 10: explicit commit/pull/push-via-conversation evidence, independent hands-on confirmation of these AI-agent flows (community evidence only covers pre-Copilot mobile app basics, not agent conversation features).
